items.title: Contract Intelligence and Review Automation
items.description: New York's transaction-intensive BigLaw and corporate legal departments review thousands of contracts per year — NDAs, commercial agreements, loan documents, ISDA agreements, real estate contracts. AI extracting key provisions, flagging risk clauses, and surfacing non-standard language reduces associate review time by 40–70% on routine contract types, freeing attorney time for judgment-requiring work. New York applications: M&A due diligence document review, real estate contract analysis, financial document intelligence, master service agreement review. Typical cost: $45,000–$115,000 | Timeline: 12–20 weeks.

items.title: Legal Research RAG

Enabling associates to ask 'what's our position on force majeure in commercial leases governed by New York law?' and receive cited, source-attributed answers from the firm's own precedent.
